scope: bounded streaming RAW/ZLIB preparation and original-byte length/SHA validation; private staging only, no HTML normalization, SQL/index/ref/cursor commit or ordinary cleanup
prepare: copy exact original bytes to owned raw stage, SHA256 original and incrementally deflate to bounded candidate. RAW fallback when candidate incomplete/exceeds packed budget or insufficient actual framing-inclusive saving; never truncate originals. Caller retains source/stage ownership.
selection: same RBMOBJ1 final size =124+payload+20*max(1,ceil(payload/32768)); choose ZLIB only when full candidate saves at least max(32B,ceil(5% RAW framed size)). If selected RAW exceeds admitted packed limit, report resource limit rather than silently truncate or weaken minimum-saving policy.
budgets: native Limits maxOriginal/maxPacked nonnegative <=U32 frame capacity; no allocation by these sizes. fixed32KiB input/output buffers; candidate prefix cannot exceed maxPacked, abandoned candidate must remain unpublished/discarded by native stage owner
codec: platform zlib wrapper, Deflater level6 or9 explicit enum, no gzip/zstd/dictionary/new dependency
decode: expected codec/original size/packed size/SHA come from native authenticated catalog/frame chain; exact packed EOF, RAW size equality, complete inflater end/no dictionary/no surplus, original bound+exact length+digest required before successful return. Never hand unverified compressed stream straight to public sink.
failure: private output may contain prefix/body before a later checksum/EOF/tag/upstream cancellation error: caller must abandon stage and not publish. Codec success is not frame authentication or commit authority.
cancellation: cooperative per read/deflate/inflate/write boundary; no assumption it interrupts blocked IO or settles actual task. Outputs/source not closed or flushed by helper; Deflater/Inflater native state always ended.
resourceNotAuthority: resource/codec errors are not insufficient administrator level; caller reports bounded policy condition without retrying effects automatically
requiredTests: lossless exact bytes including Unicode/HTML without stripping
small/random expansion RAW fallback and framed savings threshold
compressed candidate cap fallback without overrunning cap
HOST prepare->AEAD seal/open->bounded decode with public dummy key, private stages and no DB publication
integrationGate: native epoch/account/key/stage ownership, AEAD full framing success, original verification and latest generation/fence/atomic SQLite ref/cursor commit all required before UI/export result; this helper does not perform them
